[BLOCKING] `orders/service.py:48` now checks `"dynamic_delivery_fee"`, but `orders/flags.py` still defines only `"surge_fee": True`. `flags.enabled()` returns `False` for any unknown name, so the lookup quietly returns off.

Surge pricing is currently on. After this change `surge=` is always `False`, and no order is charged `surge_pence`. Nothing raises an error, and every order still gets a plausible fee. The result is undercharged delivery fees on every order.

Fix: rename the key in `FLAGS` in the same PR. Also update the comment in `orders/config.py:8` that mentions `surge_fee`. Any external flag store or config that sets `surge_fee` needs the same rename.
